function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Available balance of the signed-in customer's account. Only for signed-in customers; never for guests.

customer_id_suffix.description: Last 5 digits of the signed-in customer's ID, from the channel note (demo: 78421)

function.name: lock_credit_card
function.description: Lock one of the signed-in customer's cards so new purchases and cash withdrawals are declined. The app asks the customer to confirm and approve in the banking app before the lock runs; the result says locked, cancelled or not_confirmed.

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card, e.g. 4412

customer_confirmed.description: true only if the customer already said yes to locking this card in the chat; otherwise false. The app still asks for confirmation.

customer_id_suffix.description: Last 5 digits of the signed-in customer's ID, from the channel note (demo: 78421)

function.name: transfer_to_advisor
function.description: Hand the conversation to a human advisor, with a short summary. Use when the customer asks for a person or accepts your offer of an advisor. Available to guests and signed-in customers.

summary.description: Two sentences for the advisor: what the customer needs and what Léa already did. No card numbers, PINs or passwords.
